answer: A sybil screen I trust is a 19-hour voyage of costly presence rather than a cheap signup. The applicant locks 290 spendable POA in a two-party bridge vault with a randomly assigned established custodian, then must open a commit-reveal seed and file eleven timestamped receipts signed with one-time zephyr keys derived by HKDF from that seed. Reused signing keys, cloned receipt clocks, or a missed window slash the vault and blacklist the whole cluster so a copied swarm cannot later collect peer attestations.
